title: Gaaddidduu Teessoo Duuba
intro: Mooraa mootummaa durii jabaa, bakka bulchaan humna guddaa qabu tokko akka waaqa ummata hundumaa irratti of labse keessa dhaabbatta. Bulchaa kana cinatti hojjetaan of kenne, hawwii guddaa mootummaa sanaaf imaanaa itti kenname tokkotu jira. Waliin ta’uun akeekkachiisa ergamaa isaan qajeelchuuf ergame dhaggeeffachuu diduudhaan shira xaxanii fi karoorfatu. Hojjetaan amanamaan kun eenyu akka taʼe adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Mootummaa jabaa nama humna guddaa qabuu fi namoota hundumaa irratti waaqummaa himateen bulfamu keessa jiraadhe.
Hawwii fi ajaja isaanii hunda raawwachuudhaan tajaajilaa bulchaa kanaa isa amanamaa taʼee tajaajileera.
Gaafa ergamaan Rabbii tokko dhugaatti nu waamaa gara dachee keenya dhufu, aniifi bulchaan kiyya dhaggeeffachuu didde.
Ibidda guddaa akkan qabsiisuu fi ijaarsa guddaadhaaf cilee suphee akkan qopheessu na ajajameera.
Bulchaan koo caasaa olkaʼaa ol kaʼee ofii isaatii samii gaʼu dhaabuu barbaade.
Dhumarratti, bulchaan koo, waraanni keenya, aniifi waraanni keenya haxaa’amee gadi fageenya galaanaa keessatti liqimfamne.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
